entities.name: George Hazelwood Locket
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: George Hazelwood Locket was a British arachnologist who shared the 1974 H. H. Bloomer Award with A. F. Millidge. He and Millidge co-wrote British Spiders, volumes I and II. He studied at the University of Oxford.
